changeSet.author: gdd-final

preConditions.onFailMessage: gdd-final: legacy rows without a core counterpart; nothing dropped. Run SELECT * FROM public.gdd_final_uncovered() WHERE uncovered > 0

changeSet.comment: Whole census at zero, then every foreign key pointing at a table the closure drops is removed (whatever its name), so that the drops below depend on no constraint left by an older changelog.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE fk RECORD; BEGIN FOR fk IN SELECT c.conname, c.conrelid::regclass AS owner FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND c.confrelid IN ( SELECT to_regclass('public.' || t) FROM unnest(ARRAY['announcements', 'responses', 'packets', 'evaluations', 'payments', 'relay_deposits', 'person_addresses', 'addresses', 'notifications', 'notification_annonces', 'notification_livraisons', 'password_tokens', 'delivery_person_pricing', 'users', 'persons', 'clients', 'delivery_persons', 'logistics']) AS t WHERE to_regclass('public.' || t) IS NOT NULL) LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', fk.owner, fk.conname); END LOOP; END $$;

changeSet.author: gdd-final

preConditions.onFailMessage: gdd-final-903: legacy rows not copied to the core; nothing dropped. Run SELECT * FROM public.gdd_final_uncovered() WHERE uncovered > 0
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COALESCE(sum(uncovered), 0) FROM public.gdd_final_uncovered() WHERE item IN ('announcements', 'responses', 'packets', 'evaluations', 'payments', 'relay_deposits', 'addresses', 'person_addresses')

changeSet.comment: Tables whose rows were copied to the core with the same ids (lots L1-L4): announcements → tnt_delivery_announcements, responses → tnt_announcement_responses, packets → tnt_parcels, evaluations → tnt_tp_ratings, payments (PAID) → billing.wallet_settlements, relay_deposits → tnt_hub_package_entries, addresses / person_addresses → tnt_geography.
